task_distinction:
IMPORTANT DISTINCTION FOR RESEARCH DOCUMENTATION:
==================================================

EXISTING STATUS CLASSIFICATION (implemented in this project):
- Uses current clinical measurements, survey responses, or symptoms.
- Classifies whether a subject currently has or does not have diabetes.
- All three datasets in this project are used for status classification.

FUTURE RISK PREDICTION (NOT implemented — requires longitudinal data):
- Requires repeated measurements over time.
- Requires a defined follow-up period with confirmed outcomes.
- Requires subjects who were diabetes-free at baseline.
- None of the three datasets used in this project are longitudinal.
- Genuine future risk prediction is listed as a future research opportunity.

This distinction must be preserved in all code comments, notebooks,
API responses, frontend display text, and research documentation.

target_investigation.prediabetes_handling: In the CDC diabetes_binary dataset, the target is binary: 0 = No Diabetes (or prediabetes excluded/categorized as non-diabetic), 1 = Diagnosed Diabetes. Class 1 accounts for ~13.9% of the surveyed population.

duplicate_investigation.scientific_justification: BRFSS 2015 contains 253,680 respondents surveyed across discrete categorical features. Due to feature discretization (Age has 13 bins, Income has 8 bins, binary flags for health conditions), it is mathematically inevitable that different individuals provide identical survey responses. Dropping duplicate rows would bias the prevalence distribution.

features_documentation.CholCheck: 0 = no cholesterol check in 5 years, 1 = yes
features_documentation.Smoker: Have you smoked at least 100 cigarettes in your entire life? [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.Stroke: (Ever told) you had a stroke. 0 = no, 1 = yes
features_documentation.HeartDiseaseorAttack: Coronary heart disease (CHD) or myocardial infarction (MI) [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.PhysActivity: Physical activity in past 30 days - not including job [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.Fruits: Consume Fruit 1 or more times per day [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.Veggies: Consume Vegetables 1 or more times per day [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.HvyAlcoholConsump: Heavy drinkers (adult men >=14 drinks/week and women >=7 drinks/week) [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.AnyHealthcare: Have any kind of health care coverage [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.NoDocbcCost: Was there a time in the past 12 months when you needed to see a doctor but could not because of cost? [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.GenHlth: Would you say that in general your health is: 1 = excellent, 2 = very good, 3 = good, 4 = fair, 5 = poor
features_documentation.MentHlth: Now thinking about your mental health, which includes stress, depression, and problems with emotions, for how many days during the past 30 days was your mental health not good? (0-30)
features_documentation.PhysHlth: Now thinking about your physical health, which includes physical illness and injury, for how many days during the past 30 days was your physical health not good? (0-30)
features_documentation.DiffWalk: Do you have serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs? [0 = no, 1 = yes]
features_documentation.Education: Education level (1 = never attended school or only kindergarten, 6 = 4 years of college or more)
features_documentation.Income: Income scale (1 = less than $10,000, 8 = $75,000 or more)
